scope: Strict authenticated AI-summary draft request and response contracts
checks_cover: OpenAPI publishes strict request and response schemas for authenticated private AI-summary draft creation
Invalid summary type, UUID, extra identity fields, and malformed location are rejected before service dispatch
Successful responses are bound to the requested location and summary type and reject undeclared/private fields
Lifecycle status, content bounds, unique declared source tables, UUID source samples, count/truncation invariants, and optional scope labels are validated
201 creation, 200 idempotent replay, reviewed-state replay, and sanitized no-store failures are preserved
Draft and human-review routes share the same bounded source-reference model
rollback: Revert the shared source-reference model, Gateway request/response validation, focused tests, and evidence; no database rollback is required.
